shouldFix.title: The G21 containment limb is absent from both the design-leftover and qualification partitions
shouldFix.detail: Doctor v4 does not place the full doctor evidence remainder solely at G12. ID-DEP-11 says the acceptance harness rides on DR-G12 plus DR-G21 for the containment behavior of a CA-1 probe's process tree. FC-NC's consented variant requires exactly one supervised process, and v4's supervisionHonesty expressly says cancellation and reaping of that process tree is the containment behavior G21 covers. The live G21 row has the owning claim, owner, and named-but-not-authored identifier harness.DR-G21.component-failure-containment. The subject nevertheless lists only G12 in liveGateOwners, lists only a G12 harness-specification design leftover, and classifies all twelve doctor-class execution under OBL-G12-EXECUTION. It therefore drops both the unauthored G21 harness-specification limb and the later G21 containment qualification limb. This makes the purported source-exhaustive D-056 partition incomplete even though the candidate correctly refuses SATISFIED and closure.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Add the G21 limb without inventing it: classify authoring the already-named G21 harness specification, as needed for the FC-NC CA-1 process-tree containment property, as design work; classify execution of that containment property as qualification at G21 with the live owner Supervisor + protocol + operability. Update liveGateOwners, the summary, doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone, and proposedLaterWork. Keep the broader doctor/purge evidence at G12, keep both harnesses unauthored and not QUALIFIED, execute no fixture, and assign no new gate number. A distinct G21 specification obligation and a distinct G21 execution obligation are the clearest repair.

advisories.title: The honesty obligation names only the D-035 advisories
advisories.detail: The adopted D-127 decision says CLAUDE-D127-A1 and CLAUDE-D127-A2 travel as honesty work, and D-129 says CLAUDE-DAJ7-A1 travels as honesty work. The subject's sole honesty obligation names only D-035 A1-A6. The recorded candidates remain pinned and unapplied, so this does not erase the traveling advisories or change leftover eligibility, but the explicit honesty ledger is narrower than the directly relevant DR-114 recording chain.
advisories.suggestion: Enumerate the D-127 and D-129 traveling advisories, or state that all honesty work carried by those adopted recordings remains incorporated by reference.

summary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX, with one advisory. The candidate correctly keeps DR-114 OPEN, leaves Class A unopened, preserves FC-C1 and BLK-1..4 as leftovers, excludes BLK-5/6/7, separates fixture authoring from execution, refuses to force the thirteen actor-join classes onto G09, changes no required-now count, and applies or executes nothing. The partition is nevertheless incomplete against doctor v4: ID-DEP-11 and FC-NC put the CA-1 probe's process-tree containment at G21 as well as the broader doctor evidence at G12. Because G21's named harness is also unauthored and not QUALIFIED, the join must carry a G21 harness-specification design limb and a G21 execution qualification limb rather than assigning every doctor class only to G12. No subject, source, file-08, COORD, FC-C1, candidate-application, gate, fixture, D9, D-096 grant, or implementation mutation was performed by this review.

consideredAndDeclined.item: Escalating the missing G21 limbs to a blocker
consideredAndDeclined.whyDeclined: The omission makes the partition incomplete, but the candidate still refuses closure, leaves D-056 gates 2 and 3 false, opens no class, and authorizes no application or implementation. A mandatory successor repair is proportionate.

consideredAndDeclined.item: Forcing the thirteen actor-join classes onto G09 because v8's frozen prose says execution remains there
consideredAndDeclined.whyDeclined: A recorded candidate that binds NOTHING cannot enlarge G09's live claim. G09 owns permission request/grant/denial and enforcement/disclosure truth, not the heterogeneous actor-join corpus as a whole. The candidate correctly keeps that route as design leftover.
